outcome: relative abundance of specific bacterial taxa (Staphylococcus, Lactobacillus, Enterococcus, Achromobacter, Streptococcus, Acinetobacter)
cohort: The study included 252 participants from the Shanghai Donor Human Milk Bank, Shanghai Children's Hospital.
finding: Breastfeeding mode was identified as a pivotal determinant of human milk microbial composition, with indirect breastfeeding associated with lower bacterial diversity and higher Staphylococcus abundance.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a higher relative abundance of Staphylococcus in donor human milk.
